title: NewsStoryPublishedPayload
description: news.story.published v1 (OpenVibe.News server/domain/publication.js afterChange, via openvibe-publishing/index-hooks publicationEvent). An editor published a story that was a draft or unpublished (news.story.publish, stories.js publish), in the transaction of the change. For subscribers other than Search: canonical URL, publication state and Search-shaped indexability, never the text (Search gets that from news.index_document.*). A story resting on fewer independent sources than NEWS_MIN_INDEPENDENT_SOURCES (default 2) is still published, with indexability noindex (unsourced). Envelope: subject { type: story, id: sty_…, revision: <published revision> }, visibility public when the gate lets the story be listed, otherwise internal, priority important (the envelope default; News sets none), actor the editor { type: user } (also when a service acts for a signed-in editor), otherwise the calling service.

topic.description: Slug of the story's topic (news_topics); absent when it has none.
